entities.name: SI acquisition procedure
entities.description: Procedure for acquiring system information, triggered upon various events like cell selection, cell-reselection, return from out of coverage, etc.

entities.name: System Information Block
entities.description: A block of system information that can be stored by the UE and validated against current cell parameters.

entities.name: Positioning SIB
entities.description: A positioning-related system information block with optional valueTag and expirationTime.

entities.name: areaScope
entities.description: A parameter associated with stored SIB/posSIB indicating validity area scope.

entities.name: valueTag
entities.description: A tag indicating the version of SIB/posSIB, used for validation.

entities.name: expirationTime
entities.description: Optional parameter for posSIB indicating when the stored information expires.

entities.name: cellIdentity
entities.description: Identity of the cell where SIB/posSIB was acquired.

entities.name: systemInformationAreaID
entities.description: Identifier for the system information area, used in SIB/posSIB validation.

entities.name: PLMN-Identity
entities.description: Public Land Mobile Network identity used for SIB validation in non-NPN cells.

entities.name: NPN identity
entities.description: Non-Public Network identity (SNPN or PNI-NPN) used for SIB validation in NPN-only cells.

entities.name: SIB validity condition
entities.description: Conditions under which a stored SIB is considered valid, including matching areaScope, identities, and valueTag.

entities.name: posSIB validity condition
entities.description: Conditions under which a stored posSIB is considered valid, including matching areaScope, systemInformationAreaID/cellIdentity, and valueTag/expirationTime.

entities.name: SIB deletion condition
entities.description: Condition for deleting stored SIBs after 3 hours from successful validation.

relations.description: SI acquisition procedure involves acquiring and storing SIBs.
SI acquisition procedure involves acquiring and storing posSIBs.
SIB may have associated areaScope parameter.
SIB has associated valueTag for version validation.
posSIB may have associated valueTag for validation.
posSIB may have associated expirationTime for validity checking.
SIB validity condition depends on areaScope matching.
SIB validity condition depends on valueTag matching.
SIB validity condition depends on PLMN-Identity matching for non-NPN cells.
SIB validity condition depends on NPN identity matching for NPN-only cells.
posSIB validity condition depends on valueTag matching.
posSIB validity condition depends on expirationTime not being expired.
SIB deletion condition leads to deletion of stored SIBs after 3 hours.
